purpose: Adds or removes a reference from a card field to another record, and finds the records a field may point to.
namedChanges: The imports are peers: `holder-reference`, `pick-or-create`, `platform-fetch`, `record-cache-kit`, `stakeholder-card-model`, `stakeholder-card-vocabulary`, `stakeholder-field-sets`, `term-origin`, `type-curie`, `vault-origin-rule` and `vocabulary-source`, plus `./cardReferences`, `./edgeItems` and `./cardIconName`; `@tanstack/react-query` stays a third-party import.
`GILBVEDA_MASTER_ORIGIN` in `channelChoices` is `termOrigin()`, read when the function runs.
`removeCardReference(input)` is `removeCardReference(host: CardReferencesHost, input)`, and in it `changeRecordFactItems(` is `host.changeRecordFactItems(`.

`useRemoveCardReference()` is `useRemoveCardReference(host: CardReferencesHost)`, and `mutationFn: removeCardReference` is `mutationFn: (input: Parameters<typeof removeCardReference>[1]) => removeCardReference(host, input)`.
The interface `CardReferencesHost` is added and exported.

The type `CardIconName` is copied from `cardIcons.tsx` lines 7-25 (the same union as `card-group`'s) so the unit installs no component for a type; `edgeIdOf` and `withoutEdges` are copied from `employmentEdges.ts`.
Comments that name a cycle, a ticket, an agent, a person, a ruling or the host app are reworded; no code changed.
